title: Extract the parallel-discipline AST scan shared by three packages
description:
internal/reconcile, internal/exec/herdr and internal/exec/subprocess now carry three near-identical ~90-line parallel-discipline scans (herdr and subprocess's added by tick x73, modelled on reconcile's). One shared helper — the AST walk plus callsParallelDirectly/serialReason, taking the package directory — would make a fourth package's guard one line instead of a copy, and keep the three from drifting. Small, mechanical, its own tick.
evidence: internal/reconcile/parallel_test.go, internal/exec/herdr/parallel_test.go, internal/exec/subprocess/parallel_test.go
